turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Can you book a hotel room for me?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: I'd love to. What price range where you looking in?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I'd like cheap.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Best choice will be the Cambridge Belfry, rated at 4 stars, but very inexpensive. What night will you be checking in, so I can get a booking started for you?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Yes can you please book that for me?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Yes, how many people will be attending?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Please book it for 5 people and 5 nights starting from monday.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Your reservations have been made. Your reference number is X1ZCL9AO . Is there anything else I can assist you with?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Yes, i am looking for a college to visit on the west side of town..

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: There are 5 in that area. 3 have free entrance while the other 2 charge 2.50 pounds.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: pick a free one for me and get me the entrance fee

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: consider clare hall, which is a college in the western area of town

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: What is the entrance fee?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: The entrance fee is 2.50 pounds.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Thank you so much for your help.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: You are quite welcome. Can I be of any further assistance for you today?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: That's all for today. Thank you

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: I'm happy to be of service, and enjoy your time in Cambridge!

records.scenario: Arranging a restaurant and a train journey

turns.text: Hi there. I've heard great things about the Grafton Hotel Restaurant. Can you find me some details about it, please?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: I can do that. The Grafton hotel restaurant is located in the east area, it serves British and is in the expensive price range.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Can I get their phone number please?

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Of course. The phone number is 01223241387. Do you need anything else?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: I also need information about a train leaving from Leicester.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: There are 133 trains leaving leicester. Can you be more specific?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Yes. I need a train going to Cambridge leaving after 19:15.

turns.text: There are several trains departing from Leicester heading to Cambridge after 19:15. What day would you like to leave?

turns.text: I have narrowed the selection down to 4 trains. Arrival times are 21:54, 22:54, 23:54, and 24:54. What time would you prefer?

turns.speaker: Learner

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Okay thank you. That will be fine.

turns.speaker: Assistant
turns.text: Is there anything else I can help you with?

turns.speaker: Learner
